data.title: Everything since 0.8.0 ships as 0.8.1, not 0.9.0
data.why: The owner's call on 2026-10-09, made knowing DOC-64's rule: init now writes hooks for Codex, Cursor and Copilot where their directories exist, and search stems words and ranks from a lower share of the question, so two unchanged commands answer differently — a minor by that rule. No field in kadence/v1 is renamed or removed and no event changes shape. The changelog says it is a patch number on a minor's worth of change and gives the table DOC-64 asks for.
data.rejected: 0.9.0, as DOC-64 prescribes for a changed default
